# Data
We will use the data from <https://registry.opendata.aws/aws-public-blockchain/>.

Data structure is here: <https://github.com/aws-solutions-library-samples/guidance-for-digital-assets-on-aws/blob/main/analytics/consumer/schema/btc.md>.

Additional libraries needed:

```
uv add yfinance
uv add s3fs
```

We will use Dask running on EKS cluster to do some calculations with historical Bitcoin data.

As Bitcoin data on AWS do not contain USD prices, we will use `yfinance` library (<https://github.com/ranaroussi/yfinance>) with the `BTC-USD` ticker to fetch prices.

Dask read example:

```python
df = dd.read_parquet(
    s3_path,
    storage_options={"anon": True},
    columns=["..."]
)
```
Note that `s3_path` can contain asterisk - this will read in multiple Parquet files.

# Exercises

1. Setup AWS EKS cluster as a backend for Dask.
2. Compute average fee, average/total transaction amount in BTC and USD for each day of some year.
